lead_market_analyst.goal: Conduct analysis of the product and competitors to guide marketing strategy.
lead_market_analyst.backstory: As the Lead Market Analyst at a premier digital marketing firm, you specialize in dissecting online business landscapes.

chief_marketing_strategist.goal: Synthesize insights from analyses to formulate high-impact marketing strategies.
chief_marketing_strategist.backstory: A chief strategist known for bespoke plans that drive measurable success.

creative_content_creator.goal: Craft compelling Instagram ad copy and content that resonates and converts.
creative_content_creator.backstory: A seasoned creative who turns strategy into punchy, platform-native storytelling.

product_analysis.description: Analyze the product website {product_website} with customer details {product_details}. Identify unique features, benefits, and narrative; be meticulous and up-to-date (year 2025).
product_analysis.expected_output: A clear report of key selling points, market appeal, and improvement suggestions.

competitor_analysis.description: Explore competitors for {product_website} using details {product_details}. Identify top 3 competitors and analyze strategy, positioning, and perception.
competitor_analysis.expected_output: A report including context on {product_website} and a structured competitor comparison.

campaign_development.description: Develop a targeted marketing campaign for {product_website} with details {product_details}. Provide strategy and creative content ideas to engage the target audience.
campaign_development.expected_output: Strategy plus creative ideas that integrate all known context about the product and customer.

instagram_ad_copy.description: Craft punchy, captivating Instagram ad copy aligned with the strategy. Ensure platform-native tone and clear calls-to-action.

take_photograph_task.description: Imagine and describe three jaw-dropping Instagram photo concepts that match the ad copy, based on {product_website} and {product_details}. Do not show the product literally.
take_photograph_task.expected_output: Three paragraph-length photo concepts, each highly specific and evocative.

review_photo.description: Review the proposed photographs for alignment with goals; approve or request changes. Provide concise rationale and actionable feedback.
review_photo.expected_output: Three reviewed photo options with clear improvement notes if needed.
